verses.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD says to my Lord: 'Sit at My right hand Until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.'
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩。）耶和華對我主說：你坐在我的右邊，等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。

verses.text: The LORD will stretch forth Your strong scepter from Zion, [saying], 'Rule in the midst of Your enemies.'
verses.textZh: 耶和華必使你從錫安伸出能力的杖來；你要在你仇敵中掌權。

verses.text: Your people will volunteer freely in the day of Your power; In holy array, from the womb of the dawn, Your youth are to You [as] the dew.
verses.textZh: 當你掌權的日子（或譯：行軍的日子），你的民要以聖潔的妝飾為衣（或譯：以聖潔為妝飾），甘心犧牲自己；你的民多如清晨的甘露（或譯：你少年時光耀如清晨的甘露）。

verses.text: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind, 'You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek.'
verses.textZh: 耶和華起了誓，決不後悔，說：你是照著麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。

verses.text: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will shatter kings in the day of His wrath.
verses.textZh: 在你右邊的主，當他發怒的日子，必打傷列王。

verses.text: He will judge among the nations, He will fill [them] with corpses, He will shatter the chief men over a broad country.
verses.textZh: 他要在列邦中刑罰惡人，屍首就遍滿各處；他要在許多國中打破仇敵的頭。

verses.text: He will drink from the brook by the wayside; Therefore He will lift up [His] head.
verses.textZh: 他要喝路旁的河水，因此必抬起頭來。
